pairs.evidence: src/lib/memory/scan-feed.ts:244 A person's PATCH to done is written to Shared Org Memory with the scan-pipeline stamp and confidence 1.0 and the known actor is dropped, so readers see a colleague's claim as a machine observation, although scans-persist.ts:772 calls only the rescan witness the trustworthy close.

techniques.evidence: src/lib/memory/scan-feed.ts:244 The route holds actorLogin but the close-memory effect never passes it and createdBy stays null; the rule that a reader can always tell a machine observation from a colleague's claim fails for human closes, which share one stamp with rescan-witnessed closes.

techniques.evidence: src/lib/memory/scan-feed.ts:300 The standard grants the observation writer high confidence only because its facts are observed; checkAndAlertRegression refuses a provable rubric change and scans-persist treats a mock/real boundary as a change of ruler, but this path applies neither guard, so memory and alert can disagree.

src/lib/memory/scan-feed.ts:91 The write-time dedup partitions by org, namespace and source before any similarity comparison runs.
